SUBARU-AUTHORITY.title: Authority
SUBARU-AUTHORITY.description: On play, gain N stacks of [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold]. N is shown on the card.
SUBARU-CORROSION.title: Corrosion
SUBARU-CORROSION.description: Can only be played once per combat. If [gold]Return by Death[/gold] triggers after it is played, this card is removed from this combat (it returns to your deck afterwards), but the powers it granted do not reset.
SUBARU-YIN_MAGIC.title: Yin Magic
SUBARU-YIN_MAGIC.description: While Beatrice is present, the first [gold]Yin Magic[/gold] card you play each turn costs 1 less.
SUBARU-NINE_GENERALS.title: Imperial Army
SUBARU-NINE_GENERALS.description: After you play a [gold]Imperial Army[/gold] card this turn, the next [gold]Imperial Army[/gold] card costs 1 less this turn.
SUBARU-CORPSE_SOLDIER.title: Corpse Soldier
SUBARU-CORPSE_SOLDIER.description: A corpse soldier of the [gold]Great Calamity[/gold]. Effects such as Sphinx pick one at random from [gold]Corpse Soldiers[/gold].
SUBARU-CONTRACT.title: Contract
SUBARU-CONTRACT.description: At the start of combat, placed at the bottom of your draw pile. After the first turn's draw, it is put into your hand; it does not take an opening-hand slot.
SUBARU-WITCH_CURSE.title: Witch's Curse
SUBARU-WITCH_CURSE.description: Unplayable and retained. Cannot be discarded, exhausted or removed from combat by other effects (effects that name [gold]Witch Miasma[/gold] still work).
